第75章 坐而论道-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

书房里，余公语气轻松地谈论起目前国家的发展，讲起年轻人对国家未来发展的重要性。
“你之前写年轻人的迷茫，以及中国青年的时代之问，其实不少同志都看过。对于青年人的问题，其实大家都很重视。只不过真要解决起来，还有很长的路要走，恢复高考只是第一步。”
刘济民认真地听着，时不时谈一谈自己对青年人的看法。
“现在年轻人喜欢看文学作品，你又年轻。不像那些文艺界的老人，写的东西可能不符合年轻人的胃口。你要承担起更大的责任，文艺界现在也是争论不断，你有什么看法？”
何参谋此时推开了房门，端进来了两碗面条，色泽看起来不错。
“济民同志，首长平常啊，也吃这些。你尝尝，要是吃辣子的话，告诉我。”
“谢谢何参谋。”
“没事没事！”
刘济民尝了一口面条，在何参谋期待的目光中，发出了一声职业性的咏叹调，声声从低到高，婉转悠长，最后抬头夸赞道：“何参谋，手艺是真不错，面吃着真筋道！”
“哈哈哈，我做的面啊，哪位首长来了都说好吃。”何参谋身体后仰，满脸骄傲。
等何参谋出去后，刘济民就接着上面的话题继续聊道：“文学界的争论距离我较为遥远，尽管之前与文学界发生过矛盾，但我觉得那些争论不重要。技术解决的是社会发展的硬件问题，我觉得文学解决的是思想问题。
国家开始对内改革，对外开放。国外的思想一定会对内部形成冲击，甚至因为国力悬殊的问题，造成重大的冲击，我觉得这是文学应该发力的领域，解决‘精神’上出现的问题。
面对国外的发展和科技进步，不少人会感到绝望，甚至开始变得媚外。要防止软骨病滋生，我们就必须不断提升民族的自信心。我们要不断提升民族的自信心，要鼓劲打气儿，要鼓励大家去追逐世界一流。”
“你继续说。”
“我们要培养各种各样的人才，让这些人才真正为自己国家所用。一个国家的发展，不仅需要上层引领，更需要全民努力。”
“对的，你说木得错，这就是马克思主义的群众史观。一个国家怎么能靠少部分人呢？必定要靠所有的人民群众一起努力。
国家已经开始推动留学项目，一些同志担心，年轻人出了国，看惯了花花绿绿就不回来了。但是，换个角度想，我们每年送出一批留学生，能有十分之一回来为国做贡献就值得了。”
谁都想让花费大代价培养的人才为自己所用，但大家知道，这是不可能的。

In the study, Mr. Yu talked about the current development of the country in a relaxed tone and the importance of young people to the future development of the country.
"You have written before about the confusion of young people and the problems of the times for Chinese youth. In fact, many comrades have read it. In fact, everyone attaches great importance to the problems of young people. However, there is still a long way to go before we can really solve it. The resumption of the college entrance examination is only the first step."
Liu Jimin listened carefully and talked about his views on young people from time to time.
"Nowadays, young people like to read literary works, and you are young. Unlike those old people in the literary and art circles, what they write may not be in line with the appetite of young people. You have to take on greater responsibilities. There are constant debates in the literary and art circles now. What do you think?"
At this time, Staff Officer He opened the door and brought in two bowls of noodles. The color looked good.
"Comrade Jimin, the leader usually eats these too. Try it and tell me if it tastes spicy."
"Thank you, Counselor He."
"It's okay, it's okay!"
Liu Jimin took a bite of the noodles, and under the expectant gaze of Staff He, he let out a professional aria. His voice went from low to high, melodious and long, and finally he raised his head and praised: "Counsel He, your craftsmanship is really good, and the noodles are really chewy!"
"Hahaha, the noodles I made, every leader who came here said they were delicious." Staff He leaned back, his face full of pride.
After Consultant He left, Liu Jimin continued the conversation: "The debates in the literary world are relatively far away from me. Although I have had conflicts with the literary world before, I don't think those debates are important. Technology solves the hardware problems of social development, and I think literature solves ideological problems.
The country began to reform internally and open up to the outside world. Foreign ideas will definitely have an internal impact, and even cause a major impact due to the disparity in national power. I think this is an area where literature should make efforts to solve "spiritual" problems.
In the face of foreign development and technological progress, many people will feel despair and even start to become foreign. To prevent the growth of rickets, we must continuously improve our nation's self-confidence. We must continuously improve the nation's self-confidence, encourage everyone, and encourage everyone to pursue world-class excellence. "
"You go on."
"We need to cultivate all kinds of talents so that these talents can truly be used by our country. The development of a country requires not only leadership from the top, but also the efforts of the entire people."
"Yes, you are right. This is the Marxist mass view of history. How can a country rely on a small number of people? It must rely on the joint efforts of all the people.
The country has begun to promote study abroad programs, and some comrades are worried that young people will not come back if they get used to seeing the colorful scenery after going abroad. However, if you think about it from another perspective, if we send a group of overseas students every year, it would be worthwhile if one-tenth of them can come back and contribute to the country. "
Everyone wants to use the talents they spend a lot of money to cultivate for themselves, but everyone knows that this is impossible.
